Specify a Student-t prior

Source: R/priors.R
prior_student_t.Rd

Heavier-tailed alternative to prior_normal(). A Student-t with moderate degrees of freedom can be a robust weakly informative starting family, but its scale still requires calibration to the link, outcome, and predictor scaling.

Usage

prior_student_t(df = 5, mean = 0, sd = 2.5, autoscale = FALSE)

Arguments

df

Degrees of freedom (must be positive).

mean

Prior location (default 0).

sd

Prior scale (default 2.5).

autoscale

See prior_normal(). Default FALSE.

Value

A list with components distribution = "student_t", df, mean, sd, autoscale.

Examples

# A moderately heavy-tailed coefficient prior
prior_student_t(df = 5, mean = 0, sd = 2.5)
#> $distribution
#> [1] "student_t"
#> 
#> $mean
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $sd
#> [1] 2.5
#> 
#> $df
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $autoscale
#> [1] FALSE
#>
